messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning a staggered flip of the tenant-routing.feature flag tonight during the 02:00-03:00 UTC quiet window. I (maya) will kick off the first 5% cohort at 02:10 UTC.

maya: Who can own the smoke checks and who has rollback ready? Want to keep this as low-risk as possible (safe defaults in place). :eyes: 

sam: I can own smoke checks for the first 15 minutes. Will run the runbook and post results here. If anything odd, I'll trigger rollback.

rico: I'll be on-call for rollout. My quick checklist:
- verify canary logs and 5xx rate
- validate prefix-cache hit-rate hasn't regressed
- spot-check a few tenants via UI/hammer tests

rico: Smoke command I use (copy/paste):
```
# run sample requests against canary pool
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"input":"query test tenant'$i'"}' https://canary.redwood/api/v1/generate | jq '.status'; done
```

maya: Thanks — can you paste the metrics thresholds you want? Sam will compare.

sam: Good call. Alert thresholds for immediate rollback:
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 2 minutes
- median p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline in canary
- token-per-request cost spike > 30%
I'll post numbers during checks.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: tenant-routing.feature toggle set -> staggered (5%, 20%, 50%, 100%) starting 2026-04-12 02:10:00 UTC. Responsible: @maya. Rollback: manual toggle revert or `infra rollback-toggle tenant-routing.feature`.

natalie: Quick question — safe defaults are on, right? If an unknown model appears, we fall back to the non-canary variant?

maya: Yes — safe_defaults=true for this flag. Unknown/unsupported model requests route to stable-model-v1. That should minimize user-facing errors.

rico: For the 20% step (02:25) I'll expand smoke to include EU region checks. Sam, can you stay until 02:40 for the 50% step verification?

sam: Yep I can stay until 02:45. I'll also monitor the per-tenant error rate dashboard and post a quick summary.

maya: Rollback procedure (if needed):
1) flip toggle back to previous state: `infra toggle set tenant-routing.feature false`
2) run quick job to re-route any queued requests: `infra jobs run re-route-queue --quiet`
3) post incident channel update and assign postmortem owner if it looks production-impacting

rico: I'll be ready to run steps 1-2 if Sam calls it.

sam: If all good, I'll reply "smoke OK" after each step. If not, I'll say "rollback now" and list the metric failing.

maya: Final ask — please react with :thumbsup: when you see this plan and ping if you want a different time.

sam: :thumbsup:

rico: :thumbsup:

natalie: :thumbsup:

maya: Awesome, thanks team. I'll post updates as I flip each cohort.
